title: Invert a user-to-devices index
hints: Two nested loops: for user, serials in user_to_devices.items(): for serial in serials: ...
Before inserting, look the serial up in the result with .get(); if it is already there under a different user, that is the conflict.
A comprehension {s: u for u, ss in d.items() for s in ss} cannot raise on duplicates, which is exactly why the loop is the right tool here.
